Subject: Operator access orchestration for Redwood Private — initial checklist

Jonas,

Thanks for the sync earlier. We're about to onboard our VPC deployment onto Redwood Private (control plane in our VPC) and need to lock down operator identities and provisioning before the cutover.

Top asks from our side:
- SCIM: export of schema and recommended group mappings (we attached a small sample CSV)
- SAML/SSO: required assertion attributes, certificate rotation window, and IdP metadata
- Operator roles: explicit mappings for "operator", "admin", "read-only", and a break-glass service account
- Emergency access pattern: how Redwood recommends handling a compromised operator key
- Test plan: a staging cutover window (we'd prefer 2026-10-20) and rollback steps

Attached: acme-scim-sample.csv, acme-idp-metadata.xml

Can you share the handoff doc and a brief runbook we can follow? If useful we can do a 30m call Thurs morning PST.

Acme Corp

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <infra-ops@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Operator access orchestration for Redwood Private — initial checklist

Carlos — thanks for the clear list. I've sketched a minimal, test-first plan below and attached our "handshake" PDF that contains the operator role mappings and step-by-step checks.

Summary (high-level):
1) Identity sources
   - Primary: customer IdP (SAML 2.0). We consume metadata via metadata URL or XML upload.
   - Provisioning: SCIM 2.0 for user & group delta sync. Recommended sync cadence: 5 minutes for pilot, 30 minutes for production.
2) Role mapping
   - SCIM groups map to Redwood operator roles. Suggested mapping included in attachment:
     - scim:admins -> redwood:operator_admin
     - scim:operators -> redwood:operator
     - scim:readonly -> redwood:viewer
   - Break-glass: create a customer-managed service account with scoped KMS-wrapped key and time-limited tokens.
3) Assertions & attributes
   - Required SAML attributes: email, given_name, family_name, groups, eduPersonScopedAffiliation (optional)
   - NameID: persistent; format: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent
4) Key/cert rotation
   - Support certificate rollover via dual-key acceptance window (30 days). Recommend IdP rotate certs no more frequently than 90 days in prod unless urgent.
5) Testing & rollback
   - Staging: run SCIM sync against staging tenant, validate group membership and permissions.
   - Cutover (2026-10-20 morning PST): enable SCIM writes, perform canary operator invite, escalate to full sync.
   - Rollback: disable SCIM writes, revoke any freshly-issued operator tokens, revert to previous metadata.

Attachments: redwood-priv-id-handshake-v1.pdf (handshake + mapping matrix), plus sample SCIM schemas.

Next steps:
- Jonas to run a 30m call Thurs 2026-10-15 11:00 PST (I can host) to walk through the PDF.
- Carlos to confirm the staging SSO metadata URL and a test user/group.

I'll put the runbook into the Drive link and share post-call.

Best,

Jonas Weber
Senior PM, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
